cap.core_project_graph.summary: Core project identity, legacy graph storage, shared contracts, search and the mgraph command surface.

cap.fact_certification.summary: Prospective Fact Alpha uses one packager-selected nontruth Research package, full independent verifier review of every record/interface/edge, and Gateway-only certification. Direct-Research plans freeze exact Main anchors and each sealed component connects every added unmarked node to one through actual package edges; existing-mark plans are exempt. A packager split recommendation pauses the route and may return to a Research repair worker and ordinary proof/source supervision only after a current one-shot user opt-in; no Fact-side split supervisor exists. The historical fast lane is bounded one-to-one complete-node minor COW plus full same-verifier component recheck only. Old Candidate, adverse, Certification, and Fact commands are procedurally reserved for explicitly selected 0.x completion/audit; the runtime does not authenticate pre-1.0 provenance.

cap.fact_bundle.summary: Atomic multi-Fact bundle compatibility and communication surface over the invariant admission path.

cap.research_execution.summary: Round planning, frozen task cards, worker returns, ingestion, bounded repair execution including commit-last semantic research_split batches, static scope-owned second-subround assurance, and compact production/supervisor projections. New split production is disabled by default and requires exact Research selection plus a current one-shot user opt-in at the common production boundary; the choice is not persisted or replayed. A split recommendation from Fact work may return to the same ordinary Research repair and proof/source supervision layer only after that opt-in, never to a new Fact-side supervisor. Supervisor interfaces are strong mechanical recommendations only; package, verifier, and Gateway authority remain separate.

cap.adverse_routing.summary: Historical nontruth adverse cards, returns, cases, proposals, decisions, and rules retained for exact frozen-record validation and explicitly selected 0.x completion, which may append its old-schema records. Prospective learning/reporting/mutation are retired; no machine-authenticated pre-1.0 provenance gate exists.

cap.novelty.summary: Nontruth novelty evidence and status retained in the core store without a second scheduler.

cap.reasoning_profiles.summary: Reasoning modes, adoption advice and profile-closure repair advice for future work units.

cap.campaign_frontier.summary: Campaign envelopes, atomic Research binding, exact active heads/context/landmarks, one bounded exact Research search before every next-cut freeze, and judgment-led maintenance across handoffs and one approximately 50-minute non-preemptive full-active Main heartbeat. The persisted working state is the only sparse-update write baseline; advisory goal projection stays read-only and exact plan handoff owns rigid replacement. A heartbeat skips project reads and mutations while the current task is visibly in integrated repair, validation, installation, publication, or pre-Research-resumption reconciliation, without a project lock or repair state machine. Every material match receives an explicit nontruth attention role, and maintenance applies warranted adds, removals, migrations, attachments, retirements, or reason corrections rather than stopping at inspection. Routine output retains all heads and previews four contexts, recent items, and oldest/newest landmarks with complete counts/digests; all bounded data has a diagnostic or exact drill-down. Ordinary full head lists preserve omissions, while exact add/retire operations change attention without truth effect. The distinct recent queue uses 64 only as a high-water guard; slots are not quotas.

cap.project_background.summary: Read-only exact-byte project-background indexing and round-local chunk binding.

cap.blackboard.summary: Typed cumulative Blackboard objects, transactions, snapshots, projections and explicit indices; ordinary prospective V5 Research binds no snapshot, while an exact promoted query or write-space capability binds one explicitly and historical frozen snapshots remain readable.

cap.pulse.summary: V4 and already-created V5 multi-worker Pulse compatibility with immutable commitments and receipts; new public V5 planning is retired before state creation.
